[P2] Preserve launcher executability when skills are added on Windows

findings.body:
chunk 1/6:

Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a Windows developer initializes or upgrades a client repo, then a teammate clones it on macOS or Linux.
This chmod does not preserve executable mode in the Windows-created commit: [Python documents](https://docs.python.org/3/library/os.html#os.chmod) that Windows ignores executable permission bits. Init stages these new files with ordinary git add (src/forge/init.py:363 and src/forge/repo.py:1143), so both launchers are committed as non-executable. Subsequent Unix clones cannot run the skill's documented launcher command. Running forge sync does not repair this because differing checks only content (sync.py:569), so write_file never runs for the unchanged launchers. Preserve the executable mode in committed output and let sync repair mode-only drift.
findings.title: [P2] Preserve launcher executability when skills are added on Windows
